note.en: أَبُو takes the case of its seat; عَمْرٍو loses its tanwin before «son of» + a name; بْن follows أَبُو in case and is written without its alif between two names.

note.en: A kunya built as an idafa: أَبُو is one of the five nouns and takes the case of its seat (أَبُو، أَبَا، أَبِي); عُبَيْدَةَ stays in jarr by the fatha, a diptote.
